# Copilot Prompt Library

This folder stores reusable prompts for collating your Obsidian DnD notes into structured lore files.

## Prompts

- Full rebuild: [.github/prompts/copilot-collator-full-rebuild.prompt.md](.github/prompts/copilot-collator-full-rebuild.prompt.md)
- Quick refresh: [.github/prompts/copilot-collator-quick-refresh.prompt.md](.github/prompts/copilot-collator-quick-refresh.prompt.md)

## How to use in Copilot Chat

1. Open the prompt file.
2. Copy all content.
3. Paste into Copilot Chat with a short instruction like:
   - `Run this prompt for my current workspace.`

## Suggested usage cadence

- Use the full rebuild prompt when setting up `collated` for the first time or after major note restructuring.
- Use the quick refresh prompt after each game session to process only changed notes.

## Optional variants

- For faster processing, include `session-only` when using the quick refresh prompt.
- Example: `Run this in session-only mode.`
